_doc: Which models /oc may use (agent/oc_pick.py). The owner edits this file; nothing auto-merges it. A model id is provider/model. Each provider names the repository secret its step reads (.github/workflows/opencode.yml has one step per provider, each holding only that secret) and the environment variable opencode reads it from (models.dev provider env). paid: true for pools that hold money (router/engines.py PAID and the Anthropic key); 'unless_free_suffix' for OpenRouter (':free' models cost nothing); unknown is treated as paid. Paid runs only while allow_paid is true. Set spend limits at each provider: this file cannot cap spend.
